label: FP
reason: The user-provided value is only used to set the parameter name in the request, but the actual value passed via parameter name is never used directly in the path construction. The switch statement uses the character at index 1 of 'guess' ('B'), which always evaluates to 'B', resulting in bar being set to "bob" regardless of the user input. Thus, the user-controlled data never reaches the sink where the filename is constructed.

evidence.note: Switch target is fixed to 'B' due to guess.charAt(1), assigning bar="bob", not param
